name: Levothyroxine sodium
description: Synthetic levorotatory thyroxine, approved for hypothyroidism and for TSH suppression in thyroid cancer. Carries a boxed warning against use for weight loss.

systems.note: Replaces thyroidal thyroxine output; the labelled indication.
Over-replacement causes tachyarrhythmia; boxed warning against non-hypothyroid use.
Over-replacement causes bone density loss and lean-tissue catabolism.

monitors.why: The labelled titration parameter and the most sensitive index of replacement adequacy.
Confirms the achieved thyroxine level when TSH is ambiguous.
Reads peripheral conversion, which T4-only replacement does not control.
